spans.s:
Any Guru or spiritual preceptor.
f. (-णा)
The understanding, the intellect.
E.
धृष to be presumptuous, Uṇādi affix क्यु, and धिष substituted for the root.

n. (-ष्ण्यं)
1 A place, a spot, a country.
2 A house.
3 A star, an asterism.
4

Power, strength.
m. (-ष्ण्यः)
A name of AGNI, the deity of fire.
2 A name of ŚUKRA, regent of VENUS.
E.
धृष to be proud or overbearing, deriv. irr.; the word is also written धिष्ट्य or धिष्ठ्य.

f. (-क्तिः)
An intellectual faculty or power of the understanding, as attention, comprehension, &c.
E.
धी the intellect, and शक्ति power.

m. (-खः)
1 A counsellor, an adviser, a minister.
2 A tutor or friend.
E.
धी the understanding, and सखि a friend.

m. (-वः)
1 A counsellor, a minister.
2 A friendly or prudent adviser.
E.
धी the intellect, and सचिव a friend.
